name: Claudia
source:
The princess of the Kingdom of Daylight, and Lucious Duller’s beloved. Her father disapproved of the match and so cursed Lucious to wander in the labyrinth forever.
Claudia spent her whole life trying to break the curse but died of old age before she could.
[spoiler]In Lucious’s route, she was able to finally say goodbye to him by possessing the protagonist.[/spoiler]
translation:
The princess of the Kingdom of Daylight, and Lucious Duller’s beloved. Her father disapproved of the match and so cursed Lucious to wander in the labyrinth forever.
Claudia spent her whole life trying to break the curse but died of old age before she could.
[spoiler]In Lucious’s route, she was able to finally say goodbye to him by possessing the protagonist.[/spoiler]
